summary: Starwood Property Trust filed an 8-K announcing the pricing of a private offering of $600M 6.125% unsecured senior notes due 2031, priced at par. The net proceeds will be allocated to eligible green/social projects or used to repay $400M of 3.625% Senior Notes due 2026 and other indebtedness. The offering is exempt from registration under Rule 144A/Regulation S, with settlement expected May 26, 2026. This is a routine debt refinancing and capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No event under the specified categories is present; the filing is a standard debt capital raise with no change-of-control, activist, or restructuring element.
